$comment: Hash of each frozen version's slice in the dump it was blessed from, excluding doc/description/examples (none of which reach the generated output), taken off the parsed dump before generation runs (see lib/dump-digest.mts). Generation fails if a frozen version's slice moves, because its files are skipped and the rest of the tree would be generated against a model they no longer hold. Run `yarn generate:api` and paste what it prints to seed a version. Record $source when you do.
$source: ghcr.io/truenas/middleware:master, middlewared 20260907235919~truenas+1 (digest sha256:2206cdcf64e40c3de3f8c8eb0ddbcf3e54ce06943ab2f6c45a97f91967f82126, fetched 2026-09-08). Re-seeded together with a regeneration of v25.10.0-v25.10.5 from this same dump, so the hashes and the frozen files describe one model rather than two. The app.query/AppEntry disagreement recorded at the previous seed is still open and still sits in v25_10_0 and v26_0_0, with v27_0_0 consistent; src/generated-known-gaps.spec.ts passes unchanged, which testifies to that and to nothing else — it pins app.query alone. Events are the general hazard here, not any one entry. A method reaches a version slice only where that version's own module supplies its models, so the method side is version-correct; CRUD <ns>.query events never enter the version system at all, and every slice's events carry the running tree's entry models instead. In the v25.10.0 slice, 20 event keys therefore carry at least one model whose event-side schema declares a property that no call-side copy of that model has — 29 (model, event) pairs in all. Only one of them changed in our tree with this regeneration; the rest are unchanged from the previous seed and stay that way, sharing.nfs.query and sharing.smb.query included, whose 25.10 event payloads type the same bogus tier. The one this dump added, pool.dataset.query, is corrected by hand: its event fields are held at the call side's PoolDatasetEntry, and src/generated-hand-maintained.spec.ts fails if a regeneration puts the dump's shape back. As at the previous seed, this is not a clean 25.10 snapshot: it is master describing historical versions. Of the two things that moved in those slices, one is genuine and one is not. service.start, service.stop, service.restart and service.reload are real — public @api_method in plugins/service.py on release/25.10.5, made private on master in August 2025 by 5655280b5e and brought back on 2026-09-01 in 165c12ab93, which is why the 2026-08-28 dump lacked them. tier is not real for 25.10: no v25.10 module declares it, on either branch. The virt.* namespace and pool.dataset.encryption_algorithm_choices are hand-restored after generation; no dump reproduces either, in any version.
